prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps has been helpful overall (+4.7% average after noise correction), winning 2 of 3 tests while 1 test showed no clear effect.
Home redesign changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.2% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign changes, as only 1 test has been completed for each kind.
Predictions have generally been too high, though major winning tests (such as rounds 7 and 11) were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -7.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 22.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Full bleed desktop layout for home intro screen: Redesign the final home intro screen to a full bleed immersive layout showcasing pet interaction highlights and clear launch instructions. (why: Finish step conversion dropped to 64.8% with median 395s / mean 5815s, and support emails report confusion about controlling or showing the pet on desktop.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality selection screen before friend selection: Insert a new screen 'new_pet_personality' before picking a friend to let users select their pet's temperament. (why: Adoption step drops conversion to 70.8% with mean duration 1017s. Giving an early engagement choice helps increase emotional investment.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive story intro step before path selection: Add an interactive story choice screen 'new_story_intro' before choose_path screen to onboard users through an immersive story arc. (why: Choose path screen has a high mean time of 514s and dropoff to 76.2%. A guided story flow sets clearer expectations.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pick friend step: Move sign-in screen to take place right after pick_friend, before upload_photos and adoption_certificate. (why: Reordering sign-in has previously shown strong conversion gains (+4.7% avg). Asking users to sign in right after choosing their pet friend reinforces ownership before asset upload.)
4: [home, wait_info] Show estimated generation timer on waiting screen: Display time estimate and progress bar clearly on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets are generated. (why: Home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; setting clear generation time expectations reduces drop-offs during waiting.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom photo quality hint on upload screen: Add photo guidance hints and a helper text on the custom photo upload screen. (why: Support received emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong (3 emails), and adoption conversion drops to 70.8%.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop ready background notification toggle on waiting screen: Add a system notification option on the waiting screen so users get notified when their pet creation finishes while working in other apps. (why: Waiting mean time is 2336s, indicating users minimize or leave the desktop app during generation and get distracted.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop pet controls quick reference headline and copy: Update headline and body text on home intro screen to explain mouse shortcuts and pet visibility controls clearly. (why: Support mails highlighted user confusion after onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet (3 emails).)
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate progress counter and completion highlight: Enable step counter on adoption certificate screen with encouraging completion micro-copy. (why: Adoption step drops to 70.8% conversion. Highlighting progress encourages users to complete adoption.)
9: [choose_path, layout] Two column layout for choose path screen: Switch choose_path screen layout to two_column for clearer side-by-side comparison of standard vs custom pet paths. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s and conversion is 76.2%. Clear visual separation speeds up path decision.)
